meetings.title: Board of Commissioners Workshop
meetings.location: Taylor County Administrative Complex, 201 E. Green St., Perry

agenda_items.text: Prayer
Pledge of Allegiance

DATA CENTER DISCUSSION A. Welcome, purpose, and meeting participation ground rules. 1. Purpose: to share information about data centers (what they are, benefits, impacts, challenges to be aware of, and approaches to address them) presented in a format that allows diverse perspectives to be shared and we are not told “what to think,” but “what to think about,” so that Taylor County citizens and elected leaders are better informed and can use that information to make better decisions with the best interests of the county in mind. 2. This meeting is informational. No official action will be taken. 3. Due to the potential audience size, we are following the guidelines laid out in the BOCC's 2026 Rules of Procedure for workshop sessions to ensure everyone is given the opportunity to participate. If you have come with a comment, please ensure you have completed a “request to speak” form. 4. Participation ground rules: a. We treat each other with dignity and respect; we are all here to learn. b. Presenters have up to 15 minutes each. c. Questions and comments will follow speaker presentations. d. Questions from county commissioners will immediately follow. e. Audience comments utilizing “request to speak” forms are next. f. Come to the microphone to speak; share your name and home address; 3-minute time limit; please cite source(s) of information. Only speak once on each topic. g. No interruptions of speakers. B. Educational presentations on modern data centers, known concerns, potential benefits and protections communities should consider. Introduction of speakers: 1. Bob Cate, retired Executive Director, TCDA 2. James Taylor, CEO, Florida Technology Council 3. Dr. Mark McNees, Sustainability Entrepreneur in Residence, Florida State University 4. Dr. Ted Kury, Director of Energy Studies for the Public Utilities Research Center, University of Florida 5. Dr. Nathan Palardy, Department of Food and Resource Economics, University of Florida C. Ray Curtis – An online tool to assess data center impacts. D. Board of County Commissioners’ questions. E. Public Comments. F. Closing Comments by Board of County Commissioners. G. Next Steps Forward.
